name: Whole30 Beef Stew
desc: Whole30 beef stew with potatoes, carrots, and peas in a tomato and coconut aminos broth, on the stove, in a slow cooker, or an Instant Pot.

source.title: Whole30 Beef Stew
source.evidence: Every quantity the site had matches this page line for line; supplies the oil type and the parsley and thyme amounts.

ingredients.raw: 2-2.5 lb beef stew meat (chuck, in 1-inch cubes)
1.5 lb yellow potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
4 cups beef broth or bone broth

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot (or an Instant Pot on Sauté) over medium-high heat. Add the beef, sprinkle with 1 tsp of the salt and the pepper, and cook, turning, until browned on the outside, about 5 min.

Add everything else except the peas: the remaining 1 tsp salt, potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic, broth, coconut aminos, tomato paste, bay leaves, parsley, and thyme. Stir to dissolve the tomato paste.

Stove: bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook until the beef and vegetables are tender, about 40 min. Slow cooker: move everything to the slow cooker and cook on low 8 hours or high 4 hours. Instant Pot: seal and cook on the Stew setting 35 min.
Optional, for a thicker stew: blend 1 cup of the cooked potatoes with 1 cup of the broth until smooth and stir it back in.
Stir in the frozen peas, remove the bay leaves, and let the stew sit 5 min before serving.
tips: If the beef is still chewy after 40 min on the stove, keep it covered at a simmer and check every 15 min; packaged stew meat varies in how long it needs.
Keeps up to 1 week in the fridge or 3 months frozen in a sealed container.
